Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this warm-up match! The next set of warm-up games will be played on 20th October. At 2 pm local (10 am GMT), India will be in action against Australia and England will be entertaining New Zealand whereas at 6 pm local (2 pm GMT), Afghanistan will face West Indies and Pakistan will meet South Africa. Do join us then. Cheers!

The bowling from India though was good only in patches. In fact, both teams struggled with the ball. Barring Ravichandran Ashwin and Jasprit Bumrah, all the Indian bowlers proved to be expensive. For England, David Willey and Liam Livingstone were decent but the rest struggled. Dew also played its part late in the evening and this will be another challenge in the coming games.

At the halfway stage, India needed another 97 runs and had they lost a few wickets there, this game could have slipped away. Ishan Kishan's stunning attack on Adil Rashid in the 12th over eased down the equation for India and from there on, they kept on finding the boundaries to always stay close to the required rate. Rishabh Pant and Hardik Pandya staying in the middle and closing the chase would please India even more.

A dominating batting show by India to pocket this warm-up game! It got a bit close towards the end but it was always their game to lose. The Men in Blue got most of the boxes ticked, if not all, in their batting department. KL Rahul and Ishan Kishan displayed great form in the recently concluded Indian T20 League and showed that they are not done yet. Their opening partnership almost did half the job and Ishan extended his stay after that to carry on with his onslaught.

SIX! There is the winning blow! Rishabh Pant finishes the game off in style! Back of a length, around off, angling in, Rishabh Pant waits for it and then swivels to smoke this one over deep square leg. INDIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS!

NO BALL! Jordan oversteps this time. Not having the best time, is Jordan! Outside off, length, drilled through covers for one. Free Hit coming up now. Just 3 more needed for India! Can Pant smack one out of the park and end the game?
A full toss, around off, flicked to the left of mid-wicket, who dives that side and partially stops the ball. Two taken this time. 5 more needed!

FOUR! Edgy but India and Pandya won't care! A fuller delivery, around off, Hardik Pandya looks to whip this one to the leg side but the ball catches the outside edge and flies over short third man. Boundary. 7 needed in 8 now!

NO BALL AND FOUR BYES! Oops. Looks like the ball slipped out of Jordan's hand. A waist-high full toss, way outside off, Pandya looks to connect with this but misses. It is too quick for Jos Buttler to stop and the ball speeds away to the ropes. Free Hit coming up too.
Another dot ball! A full toss, on middle, clipped straight to the mid-wicket fielder. Hardik is not too happy with himself.
Good comeback from Jordan! Wide yorker, outside off, Hardik reaches out but fails to connect.

FOUR! Ho ho ho! What a cracking shot. Jordan looked to bowl the yorker but he serves a fuller length delivery in the slot, around off, Hardik Pandya stands tall and drills this through extra cover. Not a single soul moves. Boundary.
A good over by David! Shortish, on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one. 20 more needed from the last 2 overs!

Back of a length, around off, slanting away, slower again, Hardik Pandya waits for it and looks to dab it to the off side but misses. 'SLOW DAAL RAHA HAI NA?' is what Hardik asks Pant, which means that he is asking if Willey is bowling slow. Looks like Pant replies in the affirmative.
Slower and shorter on the body, Pandya looks to pull but he gets an under-edge to Buttler, on the bounce.
Hardik Pandya is in next.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! SKY's short stay has come to an end. He was looking to be cheeky but it proves to be his undoing. Willey bangs this one short, slightly slower though, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav makes room, by moving to the leg side and he looks to ramp it over the keeper. He only manages a thin edge, which goes to Jos Buttler, who ensures to pouch this. 21 more needed in 15 balls now!
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! He gets the placement right this time around! On middle, on a length again, Suryakumar Yadav moves inside and connects with his shot past short fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, on middle, Suryakumar Yadav moves inside and looks to work this over the short fine leg fielder but SKY misses and the ball goes to the keeper.
WIDE. Slips this one down the leg side, SKY tries to tuck but misses.
Back of a length, off-pace delivery again, Suryakumar Yadav slaps it to long on for just a single. 26 needed now off 18 balls.
Shorter length, again, Pant pulls as his one hand comes off and puts it to backward square leg for a single
FOUR! This time Rishabh Pant gets the gap and the boundary! Woakes bangs this short and Pant pulls it powerfully off the back foot towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another slower short ball, outside the off stump this time, Suryakumar cuts it to short third man for a single.
Back of a length again, on off, Pant pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a single.
Slower, short ball, Suryakumar Yadav pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower in pace, back of a length, around off, SKY knocks it down to long on to open his account.
Outside off, on a length, Yadav pushes this to point. He wants a run but is sent back by Pant.
WIDE. Another one. A replica of the previous delivery and SKY misses his tuck yet again.
WIDE. On a length, sliding down the leg side, the flick is missed. Wided.
On middle, pushed to the fielder at mid on.
Around off, flicked nicely towards deep mid-wicket, where the ball finds the fielder on the bounce. One run.

DROPPED! Liam Livingstone drops this chance and also hurts himself in the process. On a length, around middle, Ishan Kishan uses his wrists and whips this towards deep mid-wicket. He does not get the distance on this and Liam Livingstone runs to his left but drops an easy catch. The batters take one and it looks like Liam has injured himself in the process. He walks off and Sam Billings comes out to replace him out on the field.
Liam Livingstone is leaving the ground. Let's hope it's not a fracture. Also, Ishan Kishan is done with his warm-up, enough of practice and he is making way for Suryakumar Yadav.
A slower bouncer around off, RP waits for it and then pulls it to the right of deep square leg. One.
Slower one, short and on middle, Ishan looks to pull but is deceived. The ball hits his body and rolls towards the off side. 41 needed now off the last 5 overs.

DROPPED! Full ball, sliding down the leg side, Ishan looks to flick it away but gets a thin edge off his blade. Jos Buttler, the wicketkeeper, reacts to his right but drops it. The ball runs behind and the batters take a couple.
Back of a length, around middle, Ishan looks to pull but misses. The ball hits him on the box.
FOUR! SHOT! Full ball, outside off, Ishan Kishan uses his strong wrists and drives it powerfully through covers for a boundary.
Back of a length, on the body, Pant clips it to backward square leg for a single.
Length ball, around off, Ishan swings it hard towards mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Woakes is back on. 0/23 in his 2 overs so far.
Full, on middle, spinning away, Rishabh looks to flick but he gets a leading edge to mid off. 14 off the over and India need 49 more from 36 balls!

SIX! Boy, did he connect with that one! So clean. That has gone a long way! Another delivery with a nice loop, fuller, on off, Rishabh Pant dances down again and spanks this one over Moeen for a big six.

SIX! Pant didn't quite hit that one cleanly but such is the raw power that this gentleman generates, that the ball still flies past the ropes. Loopy, fuller, around off, Rishabh Pant skips down and smacks this, one-handed, over the wide long off fence for a biggie.
Floated, around off, Pant hangs back and defends it out.
On middle, quicker, Ishan waits for it and then nudges this towards short fine leg off the inner half for one.
Flatter around off, Rishabh knocks this to mid-wicket for a run.
Change in bowling. Moeen Ali (1-0-14-0) is back into the attack with two left-handers in the middle.
Shorter length again, Pant gets back and cuts it to sweeper cover this time for a single. Top over from Livingstone, 3 runs and a prized scalp of Kohli from it.
Shorter length, quicker, Rishabh Pant stays deep in his crease and cuts it to the cover fielder.
Rishabh Pant walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Liam Livingstone has foxed Virat Kohli. A flighted delivery, around off and turning away, Virat comes down the track for a big shot but loses his shape completely. As he swings his willow across the line, the ball turns away at the point of impact. The top edge flies to point and it's a simple catch for Adil Rashid. 64 needed off 44 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Adil Rashid b Liam Livingstone

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter length, Ishan rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball, on off, Virat drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter length, turning away sharply, Virat looks to pull but gets beaten by the turn.

FOUR! WOW! 24 off the over and Rashid has been spanked by Kishan in this over. Another flatter delivery, it is around off and Ishan Kishan rocks back, gives it the full thwack of the blade and finds the fence at deep mid-wicket.
WIDE. Fuller, way outside off, IK leaves. Wided.

FOUR! Another boundary and Kishan is loving life at the moment! A touch flatter, around off, Ishan Kishan hangs back and slaps this through mid-wicket. The call is for two but the timing on this shot is sublime as it beats the long on fielder's dive to his left.

SIX! Fifty for Kishan! Wow! This young man is playing freely and is scoring runs very quickly now! A 36-ball fifty for the southpaw and he will be looking to continue in the same manner. Loopy this time, around off, Ishan Kishan again gets to the pitch of the ball and smokes this one over long off.
A touch shorter this time, quicker on middle, Ishan Kishan adjusts and works this through mid-wicket. Two is the call from the Indian skipper and they get two comfortably.

SIX! Good use of the feet and Kishan is taking the charge now! Fantastic shot. This is bowled slightly fuller, tossed up, around off, Ishan Kishan puts on his dancing shoes, gets to the pitch of the ball and tonks this one over the deep mid-wicket fence.
100 up for India! Floated, around off, it lands and spins away as Kohli waits and then punches this through point for a run.
Ishan goes for a reverse sweep off this full ball but misses. The ball hits his pads. Liam appeals but no damage is done
Flatter, quicker, on off, Ishan manages just to hit it back to the bowler.
Full, on off, Virat Kohli drives it to covers for a single.
Shorter length again, slower, Ishan plays this early and gets the leading edge over the bowler's head for a single
FOUR! Shorter length, Ishan Kishan stays deep in his crease and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle, Virat Kohli drills it to long off for a single.
A quicker googly, flat and on middle, Kohli gets back and helps it to deep mid-wicket for a single. India are comfortably placed at the halfway mark.
Flatter and a touch shorter around leg, Kohli moves back and tucks it through mid-wicket. Straightaway the call is for two from the Indian skipper and they complete it with ease.

Drinks break! India have started off this run chase in a fine manner as their openers raised an 82-run stand and laid the platform. Now, from the last 10 overs, they need 97 more and if they can continue with the same tempo, then they should pouch this game. England would be hoping to snare more wickets and quickly too as they look to apply the brakes to India's charge. Liam Livingstone to bowl after the break.
Rashid is again on the shorter side outside off, a googly, Kishan goes back and cuts it with the spin to deep cover. Another single.
A touch short and on off, Virat stays on the back foot and punches it to long off for one.
Floated and full on off, Ishan goes down on one knee and slog-sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and full around off, a googly, Kohli presses forward and drives it slightly uppish. It goes wide of the bowler to long off for a single.
Shortish and outside off, Kohli opens the face of his bat and guides it towards third man for a single. 104 needed off 66 balls.
Angling in from a length around off, Virat taps it down to point. Kishan wants a run but is sent back in time as the point fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end.

Update - A word regarding the other two games going on at the moment. In match number 4 between Sri Lanka and Namibia, the former are cruising as they are 50/3 in 8 overs and just need 47 more in 12 overs. Barring any surprise, this should be a win for the Islanders. In the other warm-up match between Australia and New Zealand, the Kangaroos are at 80/3 at the end of the 10th over and need 79 more in 60 deliveries. It could be a close finish in this clash.
Slightly short and around leg, Ishan lifts his front leg and tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Timing! A low full toss outside off, Kohli leans and drives it to sweeper cover for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! KL Rahul departs after a wonderful knock. Wood alters his length a bit and lands it outside off, Rahul once again attempts for a lofted shot but this time his bat turns in his hands and he ends up mistiming it over covers. Moeen Ali backtracks a bit and completes the catch just outside the circle. End of an 82-run opening stand and England would look to pick a few more wickets to get back into the match.
Commentary.Howout: c Moeen Ali b Mark Wood

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! KL Rahul is carrying his tremendous form from the Indian T20 League. Oozing class with his sublime shots. Fuller and around off, Rahul leans into the drive, transfers his weight well into the shot and chips it over covers for a glorious boundary. A 23-ball fifty for him!
The Indian skipper, Virat Kohli makes his way out now.
Time for some express pace as Mark Wood is back on. He gave 15 off his solitary over.
Flatter leg spinner, around leg, Rahul punches it down to wide long on for a run. 5 singles from Rashid's first over.
Shortish and on off, Ishan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A touch short again, around middle and leg, Rahul moves back and works it in front of square leg for one.
A touch short and around off, KL gets back to play the square cut but it takes the under edge and rolls back to the bowler.
This one is tossed up, full and around middle, Kishan knocks it down to long on for a run.
Flatter delivery, on middle and skidding in, Rahul eases it down to long on for a single.
Change in bowling. Spin from both ends as Adil Rashid is going to bowl!
Fullish around leg, Ishan sweeps it behind square leg for a couple of runs. 14 from Moeen's first.
This one goes straight on, outside off, it's played late towards short third man for a single.
SIX! This one is high, high enough to clear the fence. A long hop from Moeen, around off, KL Rahul once again goes back deep inside the crease and clobbers it flat over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Uff...this one stays low. Flighted and full around off, KL does well to play late and low as he keeps it out towards the bowler.
FOUR! Nailed! Moeen drags his length back and lands it around off, KL Rahul uses the depth of his crease and pulls it powerfully to the wide long on fence.
A touch short around middle and skidding down, Kishan gets back and helps it behind square leg for a single.
Spin time! Moeen Ali has the ball in hand now.

Back of a length around off, Kishan punches it down to mid off. The fielder is at the edge of the circle and it's an easy run. 10 from the over, India are 59/0 at the end of the Powerplay. Strong start.
Angling into the batsman, on a length, KL nudges it towards mid on and rotates the strike.

SIX! High in the night sky and it's a handsome shot. Chris Jordan delivers it on a length around off, Rahul remains inside the crease and with a tremendous speed of his bat, he hoists it over the bowler's head for a biggie. There is so much class about his shots. Little muscle, more timing.
Short and around off, Kishan plays a mistimed pull wide of mid on for a run.

Short in length, on middle and angling down the leg side, Kishan tries to pull but misses. It hits him on the rib cage and deflects towards short fine leg. Buttler runs and collects the ball. He scores a direct hit and the ball deflects away. KL Rahul wants a run but Kishan is down on his haunches, trying to catch his breath back after that blow.

Excellent stop by Jonny Bairstow! A touch short in length and around off, Rahul punches it to the right of cover-point and Jonny dives across to his right to stop the racing ball. The batsmen collect a single and 50 comes up for India.
Change. Time for Chris Jordan to have a crack at this Indian opening pair!

FOUR! Ishan Kishan is loving the pace offered by Mark Wood. Short in length and around off, Kishan rocks back and hammer-pulls it in front of square leg. The fielder in the deep dives near the fence but fails to cut it off. 16 from the over, 34 in the last two and India are on the charge.

SIX! Dispatched! Mark Wood changes his angle but it worked in favour of the left-hander. Short and around off, Kishan stands back and pulls it with the angle of the bowler. He connects and connects so well that the ball goes whistling over square leg for a maximum. Brute.
Swing and a miss! Wood goes wide of the crease and digs in a short ball outside off, Kishan stands back to pull but misses.
Sharp delivery, on middle and angling in, Rahul fails to flick and is hit on the inside part of his thigh. The ball rolls behind in front of the keeper and Kishan calls his partner for a leg bye.
Back of a length outside off, Kishan runs it down to third man and hands the strike to Rahul.
FOUR! Smashed away! Wood speeds in and delivers it full around off, Ishan Kishan attacks it with all his power and dismisses it over mid on for a boundary.
Bowling change? Yep. Mark Wood is unleashed into the attack!
FOUR! Easy for KL Rahul. Full toss, on the pads, KL Rahul flicks it off his pads towards fine leg for another boundary. 18 runs off this over.
Back of a length, around off, KL Rahul steers it away towards the backward point fielder.
SIX! WOW! What a shot! Full ball, on the stumps, KL Rahul whips it across the line over deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Very full ball, outside off, swinging away, KL Rahul goes chasing for that but misses.
FOUR! Shot of a batsman in prime form! Fuller and outside off, KL Rahul shows a great extension of his arms and lifts it with great timing over mid off. Nearly went all the way.
FOUR! KL Rahul again! Back of a length, around leg, KL Rahul pulls it towards backward square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, landing around off and angling in, Kishan tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects to point, he looks for a run but Rahul sends him back.
Slower bouncer, around off, Ishan Kishan shows restrain as he leans back and allows it through.
Full and on middle, KL calmly knocks it down to mid on and rotates the strike.

ANOTHER CHANCE! A touch short and around off, Kishan heaves it over square leg. Liam Livingstone fails to judge the catch properly in the deep and the ball lands in front of him. Ishan Kishan is living dangerously at the moment. A single taken.

PUT DOWN! Chris Woakes did the hard work of diving and reaching the ball but then he fails to grab it cleanly. Fuller and on middle, Ishan plays a lofted shot down to mid on where Woakes dives forward but fails to keep it in his grasp.
Edgy! Willey drops it on a length and outside off, Ishan tries to step back and slap it to the off side but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length, on off, Ishan Kishan works it away towards the mid-wicket region for a single
Play and a miss! Length ball, outside off, seaming away, Ishan Kishan slashes his bat hard at that one but misses.
FOUR! First boundary for Ishan Kishan. Back of a length, outside off, Ishan connects the cut this time and smashes it through covers for a boundary.
On a length, outside off, Ishan Kishan pushes it to the cover fielder in the ring.
On a length, outside off, seaming away, Ishan Kishan looks to work it away towards the off side but the ball misses the outside edge of his blade.
Back of a length, outside off, Ishan Kishan looks to cut but misses.
Chris Woakes to operate from the other end.
Pitches it up and outside off, Kishan drives it through cover-point and picks up a run. 8 from the first over.
Lands it on a length around off, Rahul goes back and pushes it with gentle hands to mid off. They cross for a brisk single.
FOUR! Put away easily. Willey is on the shorter side with his length, around leg, KL Rahul uses his bottom hand well and tucks it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
David Willey comes steaming in but KL Rahul is not ready. He stops the bowler.
Kishan is off the mark as well. Fuller in length around off, Ishan gets forward and pushes it to the right of the cover fielder for a single.
Delivers it on a length around off, moving away a bit off the seam, Kishan stays on the back foot and defends it off the inner half to the leg side.
Edgy start for KL! Fuller and close to off, shaping in a bit, Rahul tries to flick but it takes the leading edge. The ball rolls in the gap at cover-point and they cross for a run.
